narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Half of five is two and a half, so Harmain will be two and a half.
<bookmark mark='older'/>By the time she is two and a half, her brother is six and a half.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Her brother keeps growing, so his present age cannot be halved.
